notes.title: Version 14.14 Released (World Cup update)
notes.content:
An updated version of Cricket Captain 2014 has been released, including a World Cup 2015 database and scenario, allowing you to play the tournament with updated squads and statistics (available through the “Tournament” option). 

Details of the update are included below. We are also in the final stages of adding new stadiums and expect these to be available next week. The update will also include any late replacements to the World Cup squads. 

Updae list (version 14.14):
 - Updated Australian domestic squads for 2014-15 season.
 - Updated World Cup 2015 mode and squads.
 - Additional database changes as suggested by the forum.
 - Added batting preference tool tips.
 - Fixed corrupted saved game recovery.

notes.content:

notes.title: Updated version 14.06 available
notes.content:
We've released an updated version. You will receive this automatically if you've bought the game and you have Steam updates turned on.

Fix list for version 14.06:

Database changes as suggested by the forum
Fixed “pure virtual” error
Fixed highlight exiting early issue
Grid-views remember position after Player Profile
County Championship draw points updated
Fixed Indian 20 over additional matches issue
Added Bangladesh to national team choice
Added missing opener text to batting preferences
Retains previous user team selection for 20ov/FC/OD only saves
Fixed text corruption in Indian 20 over contracts
Fixed retain/offer captaincy
Fixed highlighting of technique training
Fixed missing batting card label
Updated Australian FC points system

This update does not address the crash at start-up errors. The member of our team who was looking at this was ill on Friday, so we'll have another update early next week.
